delete.description: Initiates self-deletion (ADR 0017). Soft-deletes the user and their routes, revokes all sessions, and schedules permanent erasure 30 days later. The user can cancel by signing back in and calling POST /users/me/cancel-deletion within the grace window.

post.description: Sets a password for the authenticated user, or changes it if one already exists. HIBP/length validation always applies. Changing an existing password requires the current password. Adding a password to a Google-only account does not require email verification (OAuth already proved email control).

400.description: Password failed validation, or current password missing on change

get.description: Returns a ZIP containing routess-export.json (full account dump) and one GPX file per Route. Soft-capped at 1000 routes; accounts above the cap get a 400 and should contact support. GDPR Art. 15 right of access.

400.description: Account exceeds the export size cap

post.description: Cancels a self-initiated deletion that's still inside the 30-day grace window. Restores the user's routes and clears the pending status. No-op if the user is not in a pending state.
Authenticates user using a Google OAuth2 authorization code from the popup auth-code flow

Step 1 of email+password signup. Validates the password (length 12-128, HIBP breach check) and emails a verification link. The User row is NOT created until the verification link is clicked. Rejected with 409 if an account with this email already exists.

400.description: Invalid password (too short, too long, or breached)

post.description: Step 2: consume the verification token, create the User and password method, and start a session.

409.description: Email was claimed by another signup in the meantime

post.description: Authenticates with email + password. Returns a session JWT. Generic error message on failure.
Always returns 200 to avoid email enumeration. If a user with this email and a password method exists, a reset email is sent.
Consumes a reset token, sets a new password, and revokes ALL sessions for the user.

400.description: Token invalid or expired, or password failed validation

get.description: Returns all active sessions for the authenticated user. The session that issued the current JWT is marked with isCurrent=true.

delete.description: Revokes the given session for the authenticated user. The current session cannot be revoked here; use POST /auth/logout for that.

post.description: Revokes every active session for the authenticated user, including the current one.

Creates a new PAT for the authenticated user. Returns the plaintext exactly once; it is hashed at rest and cannot be retrieved again. Tokens authenticate non-browser clients (CLI, AI agents, scripts) via `Authorization: Bearer routess_pat_…`. PATs are blocked from `/v1/admin/*` and from `DELETE /v1/users/me` regardless of the owner's role.

get.description: Lists the authenticated user's active (non-revoked) PATs. Plaintext is never returned; only metadata.

delete.description: Revokes the token with the given ID. Idempotent: revoking an already-revoked token succeeds.

post.description: Creates a new route for the authenticated user. PATs are blocked; route creation lands with #170.

get.description: Retrieves all routes belonging to the authenticated user (any visibility)
Returns the public Routes owned by the given user. Excludes private and unlisted routes.

Returns the route. Owners see it regardless of visibility; non-owners (including anonymous viewers) only see public and unlisted routes. Private routes return 404 to non-owners. PATs hit this through the cookie-or-bearer JWT path; PAT-as-Bearer is not yet supported here (use GET /routes to list and filter).

patch.description: Updates a specific route for the authenticated user.

parameters.name: X-Routess-Confirm
parameters.description: Set to `true` when a PAT call sets `visibility: public`. Cookie sessions ignore this header.

428.description: PAT-authenticated call attempted to set visibility to public without `X-Routess-Confirm: true`. Surface the `impact` field of the response to the user and retry with the header set.

delete.description: Deletes a specific route for the authenticated user. PAT callers must set X-Routess-Confirm: true.

parameters.name: X-Routess-Confirm
parameters.description: Required as `true` for PAT callers. Cookie sessions ignore this header.

428.description: PAT-authenticated DELETE without `X-Routess-Confirm: true`. Surface the `impact` field of the response to the user and retry with the header set.

info.title: Routess API
info.description: API for route management and mapping functionality

PAT-auth.description: Personal access token for non-browser clients. Mint at Settings → API Tokens. Carries one of two scopes: `read` (list/get Routes, export GPX, profile) or `write` (`read` plus metadata-only mutations on owned routes and on preferences). Blocked from /admin/* and from DELETE /users/me. Destructive operations require `X-Routess-Confirm: true` and return 428 PRECONDITION_REQUIRED otherwise. See ADR-0022 and ADR-0023.

idHash.description: Pseudonymous user identifier for client-side ProductEvent tracking. See ADR-0020.

deletionStatus.description: Deletion lifecycle. 'pending_hard_delete' means the user has requested self-deletion and is in the 30-day grace window before permanent erasure. The web app should redirect such users to a cancel screen.

deletionRequestedAt.description: When self-deletion was requested. Hard-delete fires 30 days after this timestamp.

hasPassword.description: Whether the user has an active email/password credential. Drives password-change UI affordances.

currentPassword.description: Required if changing an existing password.

code.description: Google OAuth2 authorization code from the popup auth-code flow

idHash.description: Pseudonymous user identifier for client-side ProductEvent tracking. See ADR-0020.

deletionStatus.description: Deletion lifecycle. 'pending_hard_delete' means the user has requested self-deletion and is in the 30-day grace window before permanent erasure. The web app should redirect such users to a cancel screen.

deletionRequestedAt.description: When self-deletion was requested. Hard-delete fires 30 days after this timestamp.

hasPassword.description: Whether the user has an active email/password credential. Drives password-change UI affordances.

isCurrent.description: True for the session that issued the JWT on this request. Cannot be revoked from the list.

label.description: Human-readable label so the user can identify the token later in the Settings list. Not displayed to anyone but the owning user.

scope.description: Scope of the token. `read` covers list/get/export and reading the profile. `write` adds metadata-only mutations on owned routes and on user preferences.

expiresAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 expiry. When omitted the token does not expire and lives until the user revokes it.

id.description: Stable identifier used to revoke the token.

lastUsedAt.description: Most recent time the token was used to authenticate a request, or null if never used since creation.

expiresAt.description: Expiry timestamp, or null if the token has no expiry.

token.description: The plaintext bearer token. Returned exactly once at creation time; the API does not store it and there is no way to retrieve it later. If you lose it, revoke the token and mint a new one.

id.description: Stable identifier used to revoke the token.

lastUsedAt.description: Most recent time the token was used to authenticate a request, or null if never used since creation.

expiresAt.description: Expiry timestamp, or null if the token has no expiry.
